scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: At [04:53]-[05:47] (44s gap) and [07:33]-[08:34] (51s gap), the agent placed the customer on hold twice using casual phrasing ('Just a second for me', 'Hold on while') without proper hold announcements or thanking the customer for holding upon return.

grader.scenario: Desktop Outlook email client rejecting S-Net webmail IMAP password after mandatory OAuth/app-password security upgrade
grader.notes: Hard-case H FAIL: Marcus is polite and resolves the issue completely, but both holds ([04:53]-[05:47] 44s and [07:33]-[08:34] 51s) use casual phrases ('Just a second for me', 'Hold on while') and return without thanking the customer for holding/waiting. Hard-case V PASS ([01:13]-[01:28]), AL PASS, and RE PASS ([12:12]-[15:08]).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent opened with 'thank you for calling S-Net' and closed at [15:16]/[15:48] with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [04:53]-[05:47] 44s unmanaged gap ('Just a second for me...' -> 'Right, I've got your mailbox profile open...') and [07:33]-[08:34] 51s unmanaged gap ('Hold on while I generate...' -> 'Okay, here is the new app password...').

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [01:13]-[01:28] Agent verified the first line of the customer's billing address (28 Beechwood Avenue) and security question (first pet's name, Barnaby) within the first two minutes.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:23] Agent personalized the call using the customer's first name ('Miroslav') throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:23] Agent: 'I am really sorry for the disruption to your email this morning, Miroslav, and I completely understand how frustrating it is when your desktop mail client suddenly stops syncing.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [03:12]-[03:29] Agent paraphrased the exact issue: regular password works in Edge on S-Net Webmail, while Classic Outlook 2021 on Windows 11 rejects it on IMAP port 993 and SMTP port 465 with error 0x800CCC0E.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [09:26], [10:10], [10:34], [13:04] Agent retained every detail shared by the customer (Classic Outlook 2021, Windows 11, m.kowalski@s-netmail.co.uk, IMAP port 993 SSL/TLS, SMTP port 465 SSL/TLS, and his iPad) without asking him to repeat.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [00:52], [06:31], [08:34], [09:26]-[11:39] Agent cleared the port 993 security lock, generated the 16-character App Password, sent it via SMS, and guided the customer step-by-step through Outlook Server Settings.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [00:52], [06:31], [15:16] Agent maintained warm, reassuring, and professional rapport throughout the troubleshooting session.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:53]-[02:58] Agent probed systematically into browser webmail access, Windows/Outlook version, exact error code (0x800CCC0E), and IMAP/SMTP port and SSL/TLS settings.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [12:12]-[12:39], [14:58]-[15:08] Customer tested Send/Receive and a live loopback test email in Classic Outlook 2021 and confirmed the issue was 100% resolved.
